scope: Selected sourced historical milestones from 1950; event dates are curated, not an exhaustive conflict register. A few monthly-reference milestones have an illustrative first-of-month date; not all markers have overlapping price data. Event associations are not causal claims.

events.title: Korean War begins
events.mechanism: Cold War security escalation in East Asia affected regional trade, rebuilding and strategic supply priorities.
events.id_mechanism: Eskalasi keamanan Perang Dingin di Asia Timur mengubah perdagangan regional, pembangunan kembali, dan prioritas pasokan strategis.
events.chronology: North Korea crossed the 38th parallel, beginning the Korean War. Fighting and international intervention expanded the regional security crisis.
events.id_chronology: Pasukan Korea Utara melintasi paralel ke-38 dan memulai Perang Korea. Pertempuran serta intervensi internasional memperluas krisis keamanan kawasan.
events.market_context: War procurement, transport disruption and strategic material demand were plausible transmission channels; no comparable World Bank monthly commodity prices exist for this date.
events.id_market_context: Kebutuhan material perang, gangguan transportasi, dan permintaan bahan strategis merupakan jalur transmisi yang mungkin; data harga bulanan World Bank belum tersedia untuk tanggal ini.
events.lesson: Historical supply-security events can precede the availability of comparable price series.
events.id_lesson: Peristiwa keamanan pasokan dapat terjadi sebelum tersedia seri harga yang dapat diperbandingkan.

events.title: Bandung Asian-African Conference opens
events.mechanism: An important diplomatic milestone for postcolonial economic cooperation, not a quantified commodity-price shock.
events.id_mechanism: Tonggak diplomasi kerja sama ekonomi pascakolonial, bukan guncangan harga komoditas yang telah terukur.
events.chronology: Delegates from Asian and African countries met in Bandung to discuss cooperation, sovereignty and decolonization. The meeting was a diplomatic milestone rather than an acute military event.
events.id_chronology: Delegasi negara Asia-Afrika berkumpul di Bandung membahas kerja sama, kedaulatan, dan dekolonisasi. Pertemuan ini merupakan tonggak diplomasi, bukan peristiwa militer mendadak.
events.market_context: Long-run trade relationships and policy choices matter more here than an event-month spot-price spike; monthly benchmark prices are unavailable in the 1950s.
events.id_market_context: Hubungan perdagangan dan pilihan kebijakan jangka panjang lebih relevan daripada lonjakan harga satu bulan; harga acuan bulanan tidak tersedia pada 1950-an.
events.lesson: Do not force every geopolitical milestone into a short-run commodity-price shock.
events.id_lesson: Tidak semua tonggak geopolitik layak dipaksakan menjadi guncangan harga komoditas jangka pendek.

events.title: Egypt nationalizes Suez Canal Company
events.mechanism: Suez nationalization and subsequent war heightened risk to the Europe–Asia shipping route.
events.id_mechanism: Nasionalisasi Suez dan perang berikutnya meningkatkan risiko jalur pelayaran Eropa–Asia.
events.chronology: Egypt announced the nationalization of the Suez Canal Company. The subsequent Suez crisis involved military intervention and heightened shipping-route uncertainty.
events.id_chronology: Mesir mengumumkan nasionalisasi perusahaan Terusan Suez. Krisis Suez berikutnya melibatkan intervensi militer dan meningkatkan ketidakpastian jalur pelayaran.
events.market_context: Longer voyages, freight, insurance and shipping availability are the relevant potential channels; no monthly benchmark observations are available for 1956 in this dataset.
events.id_market_context: Rute lebih panjang, biaya angkut, asuransi, dan ketersediaan kapal merupakan jalur risiko potensial; data harga acuan bulanan 1956 tidak tersedia pada dataset ini.
events.lesson: A maritime bottleneck can affect delivered cost without an identical response in every commodity benchmark.
events.id_lesson: Hambatan pelayaran dapat meningkatkan biaya pengiriman tanpa menyebabkan perubahan harga acuan yang sama untuk setiap komoditas.

events.title: OPEC founded in Baghdad
events.mechanism: Oil-producing states established coordination over petroleum policy and market stability.
events.id_mechanism: Negara produsen minyak membentuk koordinasi kebijakan perminyakan dan stabilitas pasar.
events.chronology: Five oil-exporting countries founded OPEC in Baghdad, establishing an organization for producer coordination. This was an institutional change, not a one-day interruption to production.
events.id_chronology: Lima negara pengekspor minyak mendirikan OPEC di Baghdad untuk mengoordinasikan kebijakan produsen. Ini perubahan kelembagaan, bukan penghentian produksi satu hari.
events.market_context: Oil-output policy and expectations about future supply are plausible price channels; an event-month correlation alone cannot measure a structural policy shift.
events.id_market_context: Kebijakan produksi minyak dan ekspektasi pasokan merupakan jalur harga yang mungkin; korelasi satu bulan tidak dapat mengukur perubahan kebijakan struktural.
events.lesson: Separate long-horizon market institutions from short-horizon conflict or supply incidents.
events.id_lesson: Bedakan perubahan kelembagaan pasar jangka panjang dari konflik atau insiden pasokan jangka pendek.

events.title: Six-Day War begins
events.mechanism: Arab–Israeli war introduced regional security and transport uncertainty.
events.id_mechanism: Perang Arab–Israel meningkatkan ketidakpastian keamanan dan transportasi kawasan.
events.chronology: The Six-Day War began in the Middle East in June 1967. Military fighting heightened regional uncertainty around trade and transport.
events.id_chronology: Perang Enam Hari pecah di Timur Tengah pada Juni 1967. Pertempuran meningkatkan ketidakpastian perdagangan dan transportasi kawasan.
events.market_context: Shipping route restrictions and risk premiums may transmit the shock, but price observations must be compared with demand and production conditions.
events.id_market_context: Pembatasan rute pelayaran dan premi risiko dapat menyalurkan guncangan, tetapi data harga tetap harus dibandingkan dengan kondisi permintaan dan produksi.
events.lesson: Map the affected route and commodity rather than assuming a uniform global impact.
events.id_lesson: Petakan rute dan komoditas yang terdampak, bukan mengasumsikan dampak global yang seragam.

events.title: Arab oil embargo and production restrictions
events.id_title: Embargo minyak Arab dan pembatasan produksi
events.mechanism: Export restrictions and production cuts contributed to a global oil-price shock.
events.id_mechanism: Pembatasan ekspor dan pemotongan produksi berkontribusi terhadap guncangan harga minyak global.
events.chronology: In October 1973, Arab oil producers announced production restrictions and an oil embargo during the Arab–Israeli conflict. Importing economies faced intensified supply-security concerns.
events.id_chronology: Pada Oktober 1973, produsen minyak Arab mengumumkan pembatasan produksi dan embargo minyak saat konflik Arab–Israel. Negara pengimpor menghadapi kekhawatiran keamanan pasokan.
events.market_context: An explicit export restriction is a direct supply-policy channel; observed benchmark prices and subsequent months must still be distinguished from attributed causation.
events.id_market_context: Pembatasan ekspor merupakan jalur kebijakan pasokan yang langsung; perubahan harga teramati tetap tidak boleh disamakan dengan bukti kausalitas tunggal.
events.lesson: Policy restrictions can amplify geopolitical risk where import dependence and substitution limits are high.
events.id_lesson: Pembatasan kebijakan dapat memperbesar risiko geopolitik ketika ketergantungan impor tinggi dan substitusi terbatas.

events.title: Iranian Revolution triumphs
events.mechanism: Iranian production and Gulf geopolitical uncertainty altered petroleum supply expectations.
events.id_mechanism: Gangguan produksi Iran dan ketidakpastian kawasan Teluk mengubah ekspektasi pasokan minyak.
events.chronology: Iran's revolution culminated in February 1979 after months of upheaval. Political instability raised questions about oil production and export continuity.
events.id_chronology: Revolusi Iran mencapai puncaknya pada Februari 1979 setelah pergolakan berbulan-bulan. Ketidakstabilan memunculkan pertanyaan tentang kelangsungan produksi dan ekspor minyak.
events.market_context: Export continuity, refinery availability and inventory expectations form potential transmission channels; monitor both event-month and lagged monthly returns.
events.id_market_context: Kelangsungan ekspor, ketersediaan kilang, dan ekspektasi persediaan merupakan jalur transmisi potensial; pantau perubahan harga bulan kejadian dan sesudahnya.
events.lesson: A prolonged political transition can create a multi-month commodity risk rather than a single-day effect.
events.id_lesson: Transisi politik berkepanjangan dapat menciptakan risiko komoditas berbulan-bulan, bukan hanya dampak sehari.

events.title: Iran–Iraq War begins
events.mechanism: War between large oil producers increased Persian Gulf petroleum-shipping risks.
events.id_mechanism: Perang dua produsen minyak besar meningkatkan risiko pasokan dan pelayaran Teluk Persia.
events.chronology: Iraq attacked Iran in September 1980 and a prolonged war followed. Both countries were major Persian Gulf petroleum producers.
events.id_chronology: Irak menyerang Iran pada September 1980 dan perang berkepanjangan pun berlangsung. Keduanya merupakan produsen minyak penting di Teluk Persia.
events.market_context: Infrastructure damage, cargo risks and output disruption are the key supply channels; observed prices also reflect other producers' responses.
events.id_market_context: Kerusakan infrastruktur, risiko kargo, dan gangguan produksi menjadi jalur pasokan utama; harga teramati juga dipengaruhi respons produsen lain.
events.lesson: Track actual production, spare capacity and tanker routes, not only conflict intensity.
events.id_lesson: Pantau produksi aktual, kapasitas cadangan, dan rute tanker, bukan hanya intensitas konflik.

events.title: Oil-price collapse during 1986
events.mechanism: Oil-market oversupply illustrates commodity-price changes without a single discrete military trigger; January is a reference month, not an exact event day.
events.id_mechanism: Kelebihan pasokan minyak menggambarkan perubahan harga tanpa satu pemicu militer; Januari hanya bulan rujukan, bukan tanggal kejadian tepat.
events.chronology: World oil prices fell sharply during 1986 amid market oversupply and changes in producer behavior. January is used as a reference month, not an exact event date.
events.id_chronology: Harga minyak dunia turun tajam sepanjang 1986 akibat kelebihan pasokan dan perubahan perilaku produsen. Januari digunakan sebagai bulan rujukan, bukan tanggal kejadian tepat.
events.market_context: This market rebalancing illustrates supply competition and demand fundamentals without a discrete new battlefield event.
events.id_market_context: Penyeimbangan pasar ini menggambarkan persaingan pasokan dan fundamental permintaan tanpa peristiwa militer baru yang tunggal.
events.lesson: A major commodity shock need not originate in armed conflict.
events.id_lesson: Guncangan harga komoditas besar tidak selalu berasal dari konflik bersenjata.

events.title: Berlin Wall opens
events.mechanism: End-of-Cold-War changes reshaped European strategic and economic institutions.
events.id_mechanism: Perubahan menjelang berakhirnya Perang Dingin membentuk ulang institusi keamanan dan ekonomi Eropa.
events.chronology: The Berlin Wall opened in November 1989 amid political changes across Eastern Europe. The Cold War order underwent a major transition.
events.id_chronology: Tembok Berlin dibuka pada November 1989 di tengah perubahan politik Eropa Timur. Tata dunia Perang Dingin mengalami transisi besar.
events.market_context: Trade realignment and investment expectations matter over years; single-month price moves do not measure systemic geopolitical restructuring.
events.id_market_context: Penyesuaian perdagangan dan ekspektasi investasi lebih relevan dalam hitungan tahun; perubahan harga satu bulan tidak mengukur restrukturisasi sistem geopolitik.
events.lesson: Distinguish slow structural geopolitical transitions from abrupt supply shocks.
events.id_lesson: Bedakan transisi geopolitik struktural yang lambat dari guncangan pasokan yang mendadak.

events.title: Iraq invades Kuwait
events.mechanism: Gulf supply-security fears became a global oil-market risk.
events.id_mechanism: Kekhawatiran pasokan Teluk menjadi risiko pasar minyak global.
events.chronology: Iraq invaded Kuwait on 2 August 1990. The Gulf security crisis raised concerns about Kuwaiti and Iraqi oil exports.
events.id_chronology: Irak menginvasi Kuwait pada 2 Agustus 1990. Krisis keamanan Teluk menimbulkan kekhawatiran atas ekspor minyak Kuwait dan Irak.
events.market_context: Threats to export supply and shipping insurance are relevant mechanisms; judge price changes using the benchmark and month shown.
events.id_market_context: Ancaman terhadap pasokan ekspor dan asuransi pelayaran merupakan mekanisme relevan; nilai perubahan harga harus mengikuti acuan dan bulan yang ditampilkan.
events.lesson: A regional oil disruption can have wider effects through import bills and fiscal exposure.
events.id_lesson: Gangguan minyak regional dapat berdampak lebih luas melalui biaya impor dan risiko fiskal.

events.title: Coalition begins Gulf War air campaign
events.id_title: Koalisi memulai operasi udara Perang Teluk
events.mechanism: Conflict and subsequent liberation altered Gulf oil-risk expectations.
events.id_mechanism: Perang dan pembebasan Kuwait mengubah ekspektasi risiko pasokan minyak Teluk.
events.chronology: Coalition forces launched an air campaign against Iraq in January 1991 after Kuwait's occupation. The conflict and expected resolution changed perceptions of Gulf supply risk.
events.id_chronology: Pasukan koalisi memulai operasi udara terhadap Irak pada Januari 1991 setelah pendudukan Kuwait. Konflik dan harapan penyelesaiannya mengubah persepsi risiko pasokan Teluk.
events.market_context: Prices can respond to both escalation and the removal of previously priced risks; a military event does not mechanically imply higher oil prices.
events.id_market_context: Harga dapat merespons eskalasi maupun berkurangnya risiko yang sudah diperhitungkan pasar; perang tidak otomatis menaikkan harga minyak.
events.lesson: Market expectations may reverse when the worst-case disruption becomes less likely.
events.id_lesson: Ekspektasi pasar dapat berbalik ketika skenario gangguan terburuk dinilai semakin kecil kemungkinannya.

events.title: Asian financial crisis begins in Thailand
events.id_title: Krisis keuangan Asia bermula di Thailand
events.mechanism: Capital flight and weaker regional demand amplified economic stress.
events.id_mechanism: Arus modal keluar dan pelemahan permintaan regional memperburuk tekanan ekonomi.
events.chronology: Thailand allowed the baht to float in July 1997, marking the onset of the Asian financial crisis. Financial distress spread across several regional economies.
events.id_chronology: Thailand membiarkan baht mengambang pada Juli 1997, menandai awal krisis keuangan Asia. Tekanan keuangan kemudian menyebar ke berbagai negara kawasan.
events.market_context: Weaker industrial demand, currency pressures and investment contraction can affect metals and fuel consumption beyond direct physical supply.
events.id_market_context: Melemahnya permintaan industri, tekanan nilai tukar, dan kontraksi investasi dapat memengaruhi logam dan konsumsi bahan bakar tanpa gangguan fisik pasokan.
events.lesson: Macroeconomic and demand shocks can dominate commodity-price movements during geopolitical turbulence.
events.id_lesson: Guncangan makroekonomi dan permintaan dapat mendominasi pergerakan harga komoditas di tengah gejolak geopolitik.

events.title: September 11 attacks in the United States
events.mechanism: A sharp security shock affected risk perception and global travel.
events.id_mechanism: Guncangan keamanan mengubah persepsi risiko dan mobilitas global.
events.chronology: Coordinated terrorist attacks took place in the United States on 11 September 2001. Security responses and economic uncertainty followed.
events.id_chronology: Serangan teror terkoordinasi terjadi di Amerika Serikat pada 11 September 2001. Respons keamanan dan ketidakpastian ekonomi menyusul.
events.market_context: Aviation demand, transport activity and risk aversion are plausible commodity channels, but offsetting macroeconomic effects can change the sign.
events.id_market_context: Permintaan penerbangan, kegiatan transportasi, dan penghindaran risiko merupakan jalur komoditas potensial, tetapi efek makro dapat mengubah arahnya.
events.lesson: Identify the demand channel separately from any anticipated supply-security premium.
events.id_lesson: Pisahkan jalur permintaan dari premi keamanan pasokan yang diperkirakan pasar.

events.title: Invasion of Iraq begins
events.mechanism: The Iraq war intensified geopolitical supply uncertainty in the Gulf.
events.id_mechanism: Perang Irak meningkatkan ketidakpastian pasokan di kawasan Teluk.
events.chronology: US-led forces invaded Iraq in March 2003. Military operations intensified uncertainty around Iraqi oil infrastructure and exports.
events.id_chronology: Pasukan pimpinan AS menginvasi Irak pada Maret 2003. Operasi militer meningkatkan ketidakpastian infrastruktur dan ekspor minyak Irak.
events.market_context: Supply expectations and the speed of restoring operations matter, alongside the global business cycle.
events.id_market_context: Ekspektasi pasokan dan kecepatan pemulihan operasi penting, bersamaan dengan siklus bisnis global.
events.lesson: Commodity reactions depend on the disruption actually realized, not the conflict headline alone.
events.id_lesson: Respons harga komoditas bergantung pada gangguan yang benar-benar terjadi, bukan judul konflik saja.

events.title: Lehman collapse and global financial crisis
events.id_title: Kebangkrutan Lehman dan krisis keuangan global
events.mechanism: The demand collapse is a major non-war commodity-price counterexample.
events.id_mechanism: Keruntuhan permintaan menjadi contoh besar perubahan harga komoditas tanpa perang.
events.chronology: Lehman Brothers filed for bankruptcy in September 2008 during the global financial crisis. Demand and credit conditions deteriorated rapidly.
events.id_chronology: Lehman Brothers mengajukan kebangkrutan pada September 2008 di tengah krisis finansial global. Permintaan dan kondisi kredit memburuk cepat.
events.market_context: Industrial demand, liquidity and inventory destocking are important explanations for metals and oil; no war-related disruption is required.
events.id_market_context: Permintaan industri, likuiditas, dan pengurangan persediaan penting untuk menjelaskan logam dan minyak; tidak memerlukan gangguan akibat perang.
events.lesson: Include economic crises as counterexamples before attributing commodity changes to geopolitics.
events.id_lesson: Sertakan krisis ekonomi sebagai pembanding sebelum mengaitkan perubahan komoditas semata dengan geopolitik.

events.title: Libyan uprising escalates
events.mechanism: Political upheaval raised concerns about North African oil production.
events.id_mechanism: Pergolakan politik memicu kekhawatiran produksi minyak Afrika Utara.
events.chronology: Protests and political unrest escalated in Libya in February 2011. The conflict developed into a major national and regional security crisis.
events.id_chronology: Protes dan pergolakan politik meningkat di Libya pada Februari 2011. Konflik berkembang menjadi krisis keamanan nasional dan kawasan.
events.market_context: Potential interruptions to Libyan crude output and shipping are the relevant direct supply channels.
events.id_market_context: Potensi gangguan produksi minyak Libya dan pengiriman merupakan jalur pasokan langsung yang relevan.
events.lesson: Production disruptions require measured export or output evidence alongside price movements.
events.id_lesson: Gangguan produksi membutuhkan bukti volume output atau ekspor bersama pergerakan harga.

events.title: Russia annexes Crimea
events.mechanism: Sanctions, energy security and Black Sea tensions became connected risks.
events.id_mechanism: Sanksi, keamanan energi, dan Laut Hitam saling berkaitan sebagai risiko.
events.chronology: Russia formalized its annexation of Crimea in March 2014 amid the Ukraine crisis. Sanctions and security tensions subsequently affected economic relationships.
events.id_chronology: Rusia meresmikan aneksasi Krimea pada Maret 2014 di tengah krisis Ukraina. Sanksi dan ketegangan keamanan kemudian memengaruhi hubungan ekonomi.
events.market_context: Sanctions, financing and energy-contract exposure are important channels, but cannot be reduced to a single monthly price point.
events.id_market_context: Sanksi, pembiayaan, dan keterpaparan kontrak energi merupakan jalur penting, tetapi tidak dapat direduksi menjadi satu titik harga bulanan.
events.lesson: Map sanction scope and contract exposure before estimating commodity consequences.
events.id_lesson: Petakan cakupan sanksi dan kontrak sebelum mengestimasi konsekuensi terhadap komoditas.

events.title: US-China tariffs enter into force
events.mechanism: Tariff escalation affected industrial-metal demand expectations.
events.id_mechanism: Eskalasi tarif memengaruhi ekspektasi permintaan logam industri.
events.chronology: The United States and China implemented an initial round of tariffs on each other's goods in July 2018. Trade-policy uncertainty spread to global supply chains.
events.id_chronology: Amerika Serikat dan Tiongkok memberlakukan putaran awal tarif atas barang masing-masing pada Juli 2018. Ketidakpastian kebijakan dagang menyebar ke rantai pasok.
events.market_context: Demand for industrial metals, investment confidence and supply-chain relocation matter more directly than oil-shipping security.
events.id_market_context: Permintaan logam industri, keyakinan investasi, dan relokasi rantai pasok lebih langsung terkait dibanding keamanan pengiriman minyak.
events.lesson: Trade tensions may affect industrial commodities indirectly through expected manufacturing activity.
events.id_lesson: Ketegangan dagang dapat memengaruhi komoditas industri secara tidak langsung melalui ekspektasi kegiatan manufaktur.

events.title: WHO characterizes COVID-19 as a pandemic
events.mechanism: Demand destruction and supply-chain interruptions moved commodities in different directions.
events.id_mechanism: Pelemahan permintaan dan gangguan logistik menggerakkan komoditas secara berbeda.
events.chronology: WHO characterized COVID-19 as a pandemic in March 2020. Travel restrictions and economic shutdowns disrupted global demand and logistics.
events.id_chronology: WHO menetapkan COVID-19 sebagai pandemi pada Maret 2020. Pembatasan perjalanan dan penutupan kegiatan ekonomi mengganggu permintaan serta logistik global.
events.market_context: Demand destruction, storage pressure, logistical bottlenecks and policy responses can move energy and metals in different directions.
events.id_market_context: Runtuhnya permintaan, tekanan penyimpanan, hambatan logistik, dan respons kebijakan dapat menggerakkan energi dan logam dengan arah berbeda.
events.lesson: Supply-side headlines are insufficient when the dominant shock is demand or global mobility.
events.id_lesson: Berita gangguan pasokan tidak cukup saat guncangan dominan berasal dari permintaan atau mobilitas global.

events.title: Russia launches full-scale invasion of Ukraine
events.id_title: Rusia memulai invasi skala penuh ke Ukraina
events.mechanism: Oil, gas, grains, logistics and sanctions faced simultaneous shocks.
events.id_mechanism: Minyak, gas, pangan, logistik, dan sanksi menghadapi guncangan bersamaan.
events.chronology: Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022. Fighting and ensuing policy responses heightened energy, grain and logistics uncertainty.
events.id_chronology: Rusia memulai invasi skala penuh terhadap Ukraina pada Februari 2022. Pertempuran dan respons kebijakan meningkatkan ketidakpastian energi, pangan, dan logistik.
events.market_context: Gas supply, oil sanctions, grain exports, insurance and substitution pressures represent distinct channels with different benchmark exposures.
events.id_market_context: Pasokan gas, sanksi minyak, ekspor gandum, asuransi, dan tekanan substitusi merupakan jalur berbeda dengan paparan acuan harga yang tidak sama.
events.lesson: Avoid treating European gas, oil, food and industrial metals as one synchronized market.
events.id_lesson: Jangan menganggap gas Eropa, minyak, pangan, dan logam industri sebagai satu pasar yang bergerak serempak.

events.title: Black Sea grain deal expires
events.mechanism: Agricultural shipment uncertainty rose when the corridor agreement expired.
events.id_mechanism: Ketidakpastian pengiriman pangan naik setelah perjanjian koridor berakhir.
events.chronology: The Black Sea grain initiative was not renewed in July 2023. Uncertainty increased around grain shipments from Ukrainian ports.
events.id_chronology: Prakarsa pengiriman gandum Laut Hitam tidak diperpanjang pada Juli 2023. Ketidakpastian meningkat di sekitar pengiriman pangan dari pelabuhan Ukraina.
events.market_context: Agricultural freight and food-export access are more direct channels than metal or petroleum supply; commodity choice matters.
events.id_market_context: Angkutan pangan dan akses ekspor pertanian lebih langsung daripada pasokan logam atau minyak; pemilihan komoditas penting.
events.lesson: A geopolitical event may chiefly affect a commodity not included in a particular chart.
events.id_lesson: Sebuah peristiwa geopolitik mungkin terutama memengaruhi komoditas yang tidak ada pada grafik tertentu.

events.title: Red Sea shipping attacks begin
events.id_title: Serangan terhadap kapal di Laut Merah dimulai
events.mechanism: Rerouting through the Cape of Good Hope raised time and freight exposure.
events.id_mechanism: Pengalihan kapal via Tanjung Harapan menambah waktu dan paparan ongkos angkut.
events.chronology: A commercial vessel was seized near Yemen in November 2023 amid escalating Red Sea shipping threats. Later incidents increased vessel-routing concerns.
events.id_chronology: Sebuah kapal komersial disita di dekat Yaman pada November 2023 di tengah meningkatnya ancaman pelayaran Laut Merah. Insiden berikutnya menambah kekhawatiran perubahan rute.
events.market_context: Shipping diversions, vessel availability, freight and insurance are key risk channels; fuel benchmark changes may not match delivered freight costs.
events.id_market_context: Pengalihan rute, ketersediaan kapal, ongkos angkut, dan asuransi merupakan jalur utama; harga acuan bahan bakar bisa berbeda dari biaya pengiriman aktual.
events.lesson: Track route-level logistics before projecting Indonesian import or export price effects.
events.id_lesson: Pantau logistik rute tertentu sebelum memproyeksikan dampak harga impor atau ekspor Indonesia.

events.title: Israel-Iran military escalation
events.mechanism: Airstrikes and retaliatory missiles renewed Gulf energy-risk pricing.
events.id_mechanism: Serangan udara dan rudal balasan kembali memengaruhi risiko energi Teluk.
events.chronology: Military strikes between Israel and Iran escalated in June 2025. Energy infrastructure and Gulf shipping routes drew renewed market attention.
events.id_chronology: Serangan militer antara Israel dan Iran meningkat pada Juni 2025. Infrastruktur energi dan jalur pelayaran Teluk kembali menjadi perhatian pasar.
events.market_context: Risk premia, tanker flows and possible production interruptions should be separated from confirmed supply losses.
events.id_market_context: Premi risiko, arus tanker, dan potensi gangguan produksi harus dibedakan dari kerugian pasokan yang sudah terkonfirmasi.
events.lesson: Risk pricing can move first; confirm the physical interruption separately.
events.id_lesson: Harga dapat merespons risiko lebih dahulu; gangguan fisik harus dikonfirmasi secara terpisah.

events.title: US-Israel strikes on Iran start new war
events.id_title: Serangan AS–Israel ke Iran memulai perang baru
events.mechanism: Military escalation exposed Gulf energy infrastructure and shipping to conflict.
events.id_mechanism: Eskalasi membuka risiko terhadap infrastruktur energi dan pelayaran Teluk.
events.chronology: Reports described a major US–Israeli military operation against Iran in late February 2026 and ensuing regional escalation. Exact operational implications require source-level checks.
events.id_chronology: Laporan menggambarkan operasi militer besar AS–Israel terhadap Iran pada akhir Februari 2026 dan eskalasi kawasan setelahnya. Implikasi operasional harus diperiksa pada sumbernya.
events.market_context: Oil transport, refinery conditions, sanctions and shipping insurance are possible price-transmission channels; reported closures require operational corroboration.
events.id_market_context: Transportasi minyak, kondisi kilang, sanksi, dan asuransi pelayaran merupakan jalur transmisi harga potensial; kabar penutupan membutuhkan konfirmasi operasional.
events.lesson: Separate the reported military event from independently established export loss or trade-route closure.
events.id_lesson: Pisahkan peristiwa militer yang diberitakan dari kehilangan ekspor atau penutupan rute yang terbukti secara independen.

events.title: Hormuz disruption and energy market shock
events.id_title: Gangguan Hormuz dan guncangan pasar energi
events.mechanism: Reported shipping and petroleum disruptions make route-level verification essential.
events.id_mechanism: Gangguan pelayaran dan minyak yang dilaporkan perlu verifikasi operasional per rute.
events.chronology: Reports described attacks on vessels around the Gulf during the wider Middle East war. They signaled heightened shipping and energy security concerns.
events.id_chronology: Laporan menyebut serangan terhadap kapal di sekitar Teluk selama perang Timur Tengah yang lebih luas. Kejadian tersebut menandakan meningkatnya kekhawatiran keamanan pelayaran dan energi.
events.market_context: Tanker movements, route access, insurance and refinery export capacity must be checked before quantifying a market disruption.
events.id_market_context: Pergerakan tanker, akses rute, asuransi, dan kapasitas ekspor kilang harus diperiksa sebelum menghitung besarnya gangguan pasar.
events.lesson: Use attributed reporting for early warning, then confirm operations and commodity exposures before causal claims.
events.id_lesson: Gunakan laporan media teratribusi sebagai peringatan dini, kemudian pastikan kondisi operasional dan keterpaparan komoditas sebelum menyimpulkan kausalitas.

lesson_method: Curated event-specific chronology and plausible channels are descriptive and source-attributed; market-price changes, if displayed, are separately computed from World Bank monthly observations and not assumed causal.
